text: Code reviews are an important practice in software development. When developers review each other's code, they can catch bugs early, before the code goes into production. This saves time and money later. Code reviews also help with knowledge sharing. Team members learn from each other and understand different parts of the project. In addition, regular reviews improve team quality because everyone follows the same standards. Although code reviews take time, they are worth the effort. They make the code better, help the team grow, and reduce the risk of serious problems. For these reasons, every development team should treat code reviews as a normal part of their work.
